about_the_game:
Life & Shadow: Celestial Call
Psychological Horror – Exploration

Trapped within the seemingly abandoned observatory of Prof. Elias, buried deep in the mist of Mount Clearveil. By day, you scramble for safety and supplies; by night, you must descend into the basement where fear and madness walk hand in hand.
Escape within 6 days or be claimed by the stars…

Deep Psychological Horror

Rational science slowly slips into cosmic paranoia.
Is it real—or hallucination?
Piece together Prof. Elias’s horrific plan through audio logs, bloodstained symbols, and the notes of former interns.

Day / Night Cycle

Day ► Tasks, facility upkeep, cleaning, electricity credits, scavenging

Night ► Basement exploration, puzzles, hide-and-escape sequences, and unsettling telescope observations

What you prepare during the day directly affects how you survive the night.

Choice-Driven Gameplay

Ignore your duties, and face Elias’s wrath.
Complete everything to perfection, and you may accelerate the ritual.
You decide: will you stop the ritual, escape, or sacrifice someone else?
Three different endings await.

Atmospheric Horror & Sound Design

Flickering fluorescents, doors opening on their own, whispers echoing through the walls, and muffled screams from the basement…
Each sound leaves an eerie impression that the observatory is alive.
Even your footsteps echo back with doubt—making it hard to tell which sounds are truly yours.
Even in your safest moments, the dark watches you.
Tension builds slowly, competing with silence itself.

Mini-Games & Puzzles

You'll encounter a variety of mini-games and puzzles.
Some require observation, others involve repairing mechanical systems or decoding hidden messages.
These interactions deepen the story while keeping the player's focus sharp.

Light Crafting & Resource Management

Earn money through recycling, keep the lights on, and activate transportation routes to progress through the basement.
If the power goes out, corridors sink into darkness, and your sanity may be lost to the cold gleam of the stars.

Are you ready?

Manage your mind, courage, and time for 6 days.
Break the ritual, uncover the mystery… or be sacrificed to the stars.

In Clearveil, the nights are long, the starlight is sharp, and Elias is running out of time.
Will you heed the Celestial Call, or be consumed by silence forever?

Welcome to the Observatory.
There is no escape… unless you make one.
